paragraphs.text: I first think we had a Monopoly, then correct myself: no. Trying to remember our development cards, I recall Year of Plenty and Road Building, then think the rest were knights—but I am not sure.
uncertainties: My initial Monopoly recollection is explicitly withdrawn.

paragraphs.text: Let me check: I count seven development cards—five knights, a Year of Plenty, and Road Building.
I see this as a perfect example of killer efficiency, while also admitting that we got very lucky with the dice and with how the endgame unfolded.
I feel we are making good strides on our way back to number one.
